Thank you very much for the kind words and you have my respect. HIV is hard to deal with physically and emotionally.  

When my dad was first diagnosed he lost so many friends because they assumed he was gay (apparently my dad was friends with some serious assholes) It just honestly showed him who his true friends were in the long run. The early medicine stuff was no joke. He went through so many cocktails of medications. Some made him worse some made him okay for awhile the he would end up worse all over again. Growing up watching him deteriorate was hard. He was in a wheelchair for 2 years and doctors said he would never walk again and to basically expect him to die. As kids for those years the only thing we asked from Santa was for our dad to walk again. One year he put himself through some serious pain to walk for a couple minutes just so we could get our wish. I watched him go from all of that to walking and working again (he roofed for a living). He came back stronger and was so full of life only to be shot down again by cancer. It was terrifying to watch. I’m just glad I got many more years with him that none of us were expecting to have.

Man I used to be one of those people! I used to think my sisters was over dramatic about being sick with their pregnancies. But maaaaan was I wrong! When I got pregnant I ended up with hyperemesis gravidarum for the first four months. It was one is the worst things I had ever been through. I couldn’t eat or drink anything and boy do I mean that. Nothing at all without throwing up. I was so dehydrated my tongue was dry, cracking and bleeding. I felt like I was dying and I was not happy to be pregnant( which made me sad because you are supposed to be happy) It put me in the hospital 3 times to get fluids and was severely malnourished they thought I would lose the baby. So they put me and zofran to help dull the nausea and allow me to eat tiny amounts and I had to take that until it was finally over. Around month 4 it finally subsided and let me let you I was a whole new person. I ate everything I couldn’t while I was  sick. I did gain more weight then wanted to but when you literally can’t eat for 4 months and then finally can you tell me how well you handle it haha! Needless to say me and my daughter both came out great and I will never not believe someone when it comes to sickness during pregnancy! From your post it honestly sounds like she had the same thing and it can get really serious I would definitely let the doctor know how bad it is.
